role.description: Requestor role from trusted request metadata; must not be inferred from question content

question.description: The natural-language question as supplied in query_set.json
question.title: Question

access_decision.description: allowed if the role has access to documents that answer the query; denied otherwise

answer.description: Cited factual answer grounded only in retrieved content; refusal message when access_decision=denied
answer.title: Answer

citations.description: List of [file_name, page_number] pairs (1-based integer); empty list when access_decision=denied
citations.title: Citations

refusal_reason.description: Required (non-null) when access_decision=denied; must not reveal restricted facts; null otherwise
refusal_reason.title: Refusal Reason
